acquisition.versionPolicy: Confirm the installed product version before capture; create a new tool definition if it differs.

instructions: Confirm the installed product identity and version, plan/license state, and macOS build before opening a packet input.
Use standard file repair only; disable AI enhancement, upscaling, recoloring, and advanced repair that requests a healthy sample.
Run every case in packet order without overwriting the packet input.
Save and list every returned file in display order; mark recommended only when Repairit identifies a default or recommended result.
Record refusals, errors, preview-only results, export paywalls, watermarks, and no-output outcomes exactly as observed.
